desc: Build the Kruskal reconstruction tree using sorted edges and a DSU, assigning each created internal node the current edge weight.
Store for every original vertex its corresponding reconstruction-tree leaf, and aggregate A- and B-multiplicities at each leaf.

Derive and implement the merge DP: maintain subtree imbalance \(d=\#A-\#B\), compute crossing matches from the positive/negative residuals of the two children, and accumulate their cost using the parent weight.
Traverse the reconstruction tree bottom-up, using Python integers for the answer, and output the total minimum cost.
Verify the method on duplicate sequence values, unequal edge weights, and successive Kruskal unions.
